mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate falls below 2% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a tightening monetary policy with a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25%.
